description: This file declares the HttpCache class, which implements an HTTP transaction factory with caching capabilities, layered on top of another factory. It manages cache backend creation, transaction handling, cache entries, and related operations for HTTP caching following RFC 7234, within the Chromium project.

classes.name: HttpCache
classes.description: Implements an HTTP transaction factory with integrated caching, managing cache backend creation, transaction lifecycle, and cache entries.

classes.name: HttpCache::BackendFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating cache backends.

classes.name: HttpCache::DefaultBackend
classes.description: Default implementation of BackendFactory for common cache configurations.

classes.name: HttpCache::ActiveEntry
classes.description: Represents an active cache entry, managing associated transactions and state.

methods.name: HttpCache::CreateBackend
methods.description: Creates the disk cache backend asynchronously.

methods.name: HttpCache::GetBackend
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the cache backend, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: HttpCache::CloseAllConnections
methods.description: Closes all active sockets for debugging.

methods.name: HttpCache::OnExternalCacheHit
methods.description: Notifies the cache of external resource reuse.

methods.name: HttpCache::GenerateCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a request, considering network isolation.

methods.name: HttpCache::GenerateCacheKeyForRequest
methods.description: Generates a cache key from an HttpRequestInfo object.
